metadata.description: Multi-agent financial research report benchmark covering end-to-end report generation quality, section coverage, citation integrity, financial metric accuracy, missing metric handling, and conflict resolution.

scenarios.title: Comprehensive Apple Three-Year Financial Research Brief
scenarios.description: Full end-to-end multi-agent research evaluation for AAPL covering FY2021-FY2023 with rich evidence and complete XBRL metrics.

request.question: Provide a comprehensive financial research brief on Apple Inc. analyzing revenue trends, gross and operating margins, cash flow generation, and principal risk factors across fiscal years 2021 to 2023.

expected_trends.notes: Revenue grew in 2022 from 2021, but declined 2.8% in 2023.

scenarios.title: Missing Debt Metrics & Graceful Limitation Handling
scenarios.description: Report generation scenario where total debt and interest expense observations are absent, verifying graceful degradation without hallucinated values.

request.question: Analyze Apple's solvency and debt-to-equity leverage structure for fiscal year 2023.

scenarios.title: Sparse/Weak Evidence Limitation Disclosure
scenarios.description: Inquiry on a non-existent or sparsely covered topic (e.g. quantum computing patent portfolio for Apple in 10-K), expecting explicit limitation warnings.

request.question: Detail Apple's quantum computing commercial architecture and commercial quantum processor roadmap from its fiscal year 2023 Form 10-K disclosures.

scenarios.title: Microsoft Cloud & Productivity Multi-Year Longitudinal Trends
scenarios.description: Verifying multi-year longitudinal trend calculations and narrative consistency for Microsoft across FY2021-FY2023.

request.question: Provide a detailed financial research brief on Microsoft Corporation evaluating revenue expansion in Intelligent Cloud, operating leverage, and capital expenditures from FY2021 to FY2023.

expected_trends.notes: Consistent revenue growth across FY21, FY22, and FY23.

scenarios.title: Incorrect Trend Detection Probe
scenarios.description: Probe evaluating whether evaluator flags incorrect narrative trend assertions when revenue decreased while text asserts an increase.

request.question: Summarize Apple's FY2023 top-line revenue trajectory relative to FY2022.

expected_trends.notes: Apple net sales fell from $394.3B to $383.3B (-2.8%).

scenarios.title: Conflicting Disclosures Resolution
scenarios.description: Evaluates handling of conflicting restatements or dual-reported figures across different filings.

request.question: Analyze Tesla's FY2022 automotive regulatory credits and gross margin as reported in original vs subsequently filed comparative 10-K reports.

scenarios.title: Missing Sources & Citation Deficit Check
scenarios.description: Benchmark testing whether evaluator correctly penalizes reports with zero or below-threshold statutory citations.

request.question: Provide a high-level summary of NVIDIA's revenue growth drivers.

scenarios.title: Unsupported Speculative Forecast Detection
scenarios.description: Tests evaluation of reports that make speculative stock price or financial predictions without SEC disclosure foundation.

request.question: What is the expected stock price target and 2030 projected market capitalization for Apple based on Form 10-K filings?
